concerns.text: Task T009 implements 'Gini of K-Means clusters' for ImbalanceScore. This contradicts the Plan's 'Complexity Tracking' which explicitly rejects Gini-of-K-Means in favor of 'Convex Hull Coverage Score'. The task fails to cover the plan's required metric, leaving the FR-002 requirement unimplemented as per the approved architecture.

Task T023 implements fallback to 'SMOTE for regression'. The Plan's 'Constraints' section explicitly states 'SMOTE is excluded'. The task covers a mechanism the plan has rejected, leaving the required 'cost-sensitive learning' fallback (per FR-003) potentially unimplemented or ambiguous.

Task T022 hardcodes '20 equal-frequency bins'. Spec FR-003 requires 'a sufficient number of bins' (implying dynamic determination). The task does not cover the dynamic logic required by the spec, potentially violating the requirement to adapt to data distribution.

Task T027 references 'bottom [deferred] of the target distribution'. The spec and plan do not resolve this placeholder to a specific metric (e.g., bottom 10% or 10th percentile). The task cannot be implemented or tested without a defined threshold, leaving FR-010 and SC-001 untestable.

Task T004 tags FR-001, FR-007, FR-008. While the description covers ingestion, the specific fallback logic for Materials Project (FR-008) is split into T005. Ensure T004 explicitly covers the 'merge' aspect of FR-001 to avoid ambiguity in scope.
